thread:
tess: Starting deploy for convo-api v3. Release notes: batching improvements + optional quant tweak. Change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. We'll roll feature flag `convo_v3` with a tiny canary pinned to model=3.2. Plan: 2% (10m) -> 15% (10m) -> 40% (20m). If p95 or error_rate regresses, we do targeted unpin to model=3.1 and step down. @deploy-bot start canary please.

deploy-bot: Canary started (canary-5259009999). Applied convo_v3=2%, pinned model=3.2 for cohort. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/convo-api/v3/5259009999

omar: Heads up: last run saw increased tail for east-1 under auth-heavy requests. Recommend temporary auth token cache warmup in canary.

linda: Added alert rules: hold if error_rate > 0.6% for 5m OR p95 > baseline+70ms. Also add trace sampling for canary requests.

tracing-bot: Trace sampling enabled for cohort canary-5259009999. Example trace: https://traces.internal/5259009999/traceA

infra-bot: Canary metrics (t+9m): errors=0.07%, p95=195ms. No holds.

tess: Proceed to 15% at +10m. deploy-bot do ramp.

deploy-bot: Executing ramp: convo_v3=15% (`/ff set convo_v3 15 --by=deploy-bot --note="step1"`)

infra-bot: Metrics (t+22m): errors=1.1%, p95=360ms. Alert: error_rate > 0.6% triggered.

tess: Pausing ramp. Let's reduce to 5% immediately to limit impact. Command I'll run: `/ff set convo_v3 5 --note="stepdown-on-alert"`

deploy-bot: Applied convo_v3=5%.

omar: Looking at traces: many failures originate at auth service timeouts when batch size >8. We should limit batch size for flagged pods.

linda: Quick mitigation: set config for cohort `batch_max=6` and pin model back to 3.1 for affected pods: `/config set batch_max=6 --selector=cohort:canary-5259009999` and `/model pin convo-api model=3.1 cohort=canary-5259009999`

deploy-bot: Applied config change and queued model pin.

tracing-bot: Post-mitigation traces show fewer auth timeouts. Metrics (t+34m): errors=0.14%, p95=205ms.

tess: Keeping convo_v3 at 5% and blocking further ramps until infra and ML validate batch/quant interactions. I'll file a short incident and add notes to the release: https://releases.internal/convo-api/v3/5259009999/notes. Thanks team for quick catch :thumbsup:
